html:
The Maiawali, also known as the Mayuli, are an Aboriginal Australian people of western Queensland, on the upper Diamantina River southwest of today's Winton.

Little is recorded about them. Their neighbours were the Guwa to the north, the Pitta Pitta to the west, and the Karuwali and Birria down the channels to the south. Sheep and cattle runs reached the Diamantina in the 1870s.
sum: The Maiawali, also known as the Mayuli, are an Aboriginal Australian people of western Queensland, on the upper Diamantina River southwest of today's Winton.
